trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL cert and rotate internal CA cert
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd (buffer before September 1st expiry). Renew and deploy the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com to the load balancers. In the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert. Set up cert-manager for both certs so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed and deployed before August 22nd, auto-renewal configured via cert-manager for both.

trello.name: Implement PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: end of month. Single deliverable with two halves: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome; frontend adds an export button and a progress state for large reports. Aisha owns both halves. Also record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the changelog as part of finishing the feature. Acceptance criteria: PDF export functional end-to-end with progress state, demo GIF produced for marketing/changelog.

trello.name: Restore staging parity and add schema drift monitoring
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Two parts in one task: (1) Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it to parity with production. (2) Write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge. Acceptance criteria: staging schema matches production after migrations, nightly diff job deployed and posting alerts on divergence.
